# Site pdf edition

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Documentation site and shared links · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

site/build.mjs `/phone/` page (90 x 160 mm), pages.yml prints map-editor-guide-phone.pdf, linked from Downloads

## What is missing

wiki content in the PDF; the Cantonese PDF is on the documentation site but not on releases (the release runner has no Chinese font, and installing one took six minutes). (v0.1.209 carries map-editor-guide-phone.pdf, read back from its asset list; a failure in that step cannot block a release.)
